name: Smooth Frog 53
author: JkHuger
description: Pill amber toggle switch that toggles on and off when clicked.
howItWorks: Clicking it toggles it: background-color changes from #ffeccf to #374151, background-color changes from #ffeccf to #485367, box-shadow becomes inset 0px 0px 0px 0.75em #ffffff.
